articles.title: Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot says Netanyahu 'failed' to discredit election results
articles.summary:
Israeli opposition leader Eisenkot says Netanyahu 'failed' to discredit election results

Israel’s Yashar party leader Gadi Eisenkot said that Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and his party "failed" to discredit Israeli election results. 

"The vile and malicious attempt to deny the election results, to undermine the will of the public, to smear an entire public, and to drag Israel into additional elections has failed," he said in a post on X.

"Only someone who understands that they have lost would embark on such a brazen campaign of delegitimisation - even at the cost of further eroding public trust in the state's institutions."

He described the recent election results "clear and unequivocal", and urged Israeli citizens to "ignore the background noise".

"The people are sovereign, and they have spoken: the government of failure has no majority and it has lost," he added, referring to Netanyahu's government.

Israel intentionally released footage of Mossad operatives in Iran to provoke mass arrests, ex-chief says
articles.summary:
Israel intentionally released footage of Mossad operatives in Iran to provoke mass arrests, ex-chief says

Former Mossad chief David Barnea has said Israel intentionally released images of their covert operation in Iran during the June 2025 conflict to provoke mass arrests and make it harder for Iranian forces to find real Israeli agents.

“One of the reasons we immediately released an official video on the morning of Operation Rising Lion, with the Mossad logo, was to protect the agents who were there,” Barnea said, according to comments The Jerusalem Post reported on 25 October.

Barnea said the leak of the footage of Israeli operations in Iran was not just an attempt to showcase the Mossad’s reach but also a strategy to overwhelm Iranian counterintelligence, causing them to make mass arrests, making it more difficult to distinguish operatives from ordinary citizens.

“We wanted to make sure they arrested so many people in Iran that they wouldn’t be able to distinguish the wheat from the chaff and would eventually release everyone,” he said.

Barnea said Iranian authorities arrested 21,000 people during the operation.

Read more: Israel intentionally released footage of Mossad operatives in Iran to provoke mass arrests, ex-chief says

A tanker travelling south east through the Gulf was struck by two unidentified projectiles on its port side, the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) agency said.

The incident occurred 72 nautical miles east of Saudi Arabia's Ras al-Khafji. UKMTO added that All crew members were accounted for and no environmental impact had been reported.

articles.title: Israeli army builds new roads linking military posts in southern Lebanon
articles.summary: The Israeli army is building new roads through mountains and valleys in southern Lebanon to connect its military positions, Lebanon’s National News Agency (NNA) reported Saturday, Anadolu reports. The work spans the western and central sectors of southern Lebanon, where Israeli forces have established military posts on occupied Lebanese territory, according to the agency. NNA said the construction was taking place alongside Israeli demolition operations in the area. The central sector includes the towns of Aita al-Shaab, Maroun al-Ras, Bint Jbeil and Aitaroun. archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další zostřování rétoriky mezi USA, Íránem a Izraelem a pokračování politických manévrů ohledně formování izraelské vlády. Bezpečnostní složky zůstanou ve vysoké pohotovosti kvůli hrozbě regionálních úderů.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further hardening of rhetoric between the US, Iran, and Israel is expected, alongside continued political maneuvering regarding Israeli government formation. Security forces will remain on high alert due to the threat of regional strikes.

archive.security_status_cs: Region nadále čelí vysokému napětí kvůli pokračujícímu nepřátelství mezi USA, Íránem a Izraelem, které doprovázejí útoky na energetickou infrastrukturu v Zálivu a přetrvávající střety v Gaze i jižním Libanonu. Izrael se navíc zmítá v hluboké politické patové situaci po parlamentních volbách, což prohlubuje vnitřní nestabilitu. Irák se snaží udržet neutralitu, zatímco Sýrie a Libanon čelí vážným ekonomickým a sociálním výzvám při posálečné obnově.
archive.security_status_en: The region continues to face high tension due to ongoing hostility between the US, Iran, and Israel, accompanied by attacks on Gulf energy infrastructure and persistent clashes in Gaza and southern Lebanon. Furthermore, Israel is mired in a deep political stalemate following parliamentary elections, deepening domestic instability. Iraq is striving to maintain neutrality, while Syria and Lebanon face severe economic and social challenges during post-war recovery.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další eskalaci diplomatických i bezpečnostních tahů kolem íránského jaderného a vojenského programu a stupňování tlaku na řešení izraelské vládní krize. Energetické trhy zůstanou vysoce citlivé na zprávy o bezpečnosti námořní dopravy v Zálivu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further escalation of diplomatic and security maneuvers surrounding Iran's nuclear and military programs is expected, alongside mounting pressure to resolve Israel's governmental crisis. Energy markets will remain highly sensitive to news regarding maritime security in the Gulf.

archive.security_status_cs: V Izraeli eskaluje politická krize kvůli zpochybňování volebních výsledků a sporům o odvodová pravidla ortodoxních věřících. V Zálivu mezitím rostou obavy o energetickou infrastrukturu po útocích na tankery, zatímco USA a Izrael stupňují tlak na Írán před americkými midterm volbami. V Sýrii a Gaze nadále přetrvávají lokální střety a napětí ohledně ekonomických a bezpečnostních podmínek.
archive.security_status_en: Political crisis in Israel is escalating due to disputed election results and ongoing friction over ultra-Orthodox military conscription. Meanwhile, Gulf energy infrastructure faces heightened risk following tanker attacks as the US and Israel ramp up pressure on Iran ahead of the US midterms. Localized clashes and socio-economic strains persist in Syria and Gaza.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat gradaci napětí kolem Íránu v návaznosti na americké volby a další vývoj v Zálivu. Izraelská politická scénu bude nadále ochromena spory o vládní koalici a výsledky voleb.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, tensions regarding Iran are expected to peak following the US midterms and maritime developments in the Gulf. Israel's political landscape will remain paralyzed by coalition disputes and election challenges.
